en:
This is an official announcement from the
Ultimate Academy... It is now 10 p.m.

The late-night special at the exclusive
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Monokub Kitchen<CLT=cltNORMAL> inside the dining hall iiiiis...

I'm whippin' up a rice bowl with chicken, egg,
an' spicy kimchi! It's only 1,000 calories!

It's easy to make! Just cook fried chicken
and eggs with rice, top it with kimchi...
Oh! And don't forget the mayo...
VOILA. BON-APPETIT.
By the way...

This here's for Monokubs only!
We ain't sharin' any wit' youse!
Bam! How ya like my culinary chaos!?
So long, bear-well!

<CLT=cltMIND>...I wouldn't eat that greasy food
even if they threatened to kill me.
Anyway...nighttime already, huh?

<CLT=cltMIND>When it gets to be nighttime...
I start thinking about things...

<CLT=cltMIND>Was there really no way to save Kaede?
I ask myself questions like that...

<CLT=cltMIND>Because no matter how I think about
it...what happened to her is my fault—

Huh? Is someone here?
The doorbell's ringing...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is someone here?
Yes
No
Are you unsure of something?
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to leave?
Hey, come hang out with me a sec.
Huh? Now...? But...it's nighttime...

There's no rule about walking around 
at nighttime, right?
I'll be waiting at the courtyard.
Ah, w-wait!

<CLT=cltMIND>But Kaito wasn't listening.
He turned and quickly walked away.

The courtyard at this time of night?
What does he want...?

<CLT=cltMIND>Could it be about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltMIND>
I have? But how does he know...?

<CLT=cltMIND>...Wait. Should I even go at all?
Something...might happen...
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us.

<CLT=cltMIND>The video and sound are both overbearing.
What a nuisance...

<CLT=cltMIND>I usually slept on a futon at home.
I don't really like sleeping on beds...

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a pretty big light.
It lights the room well...

<CLT=cltMIND>My closet is filled with
uniforms exactly like mine...

<CLT=cltMIND>They went through all this just for a
killing game? What is their objective...?
<CLT=cltMIND>...Why do I have Kaito's <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltMIND>?

<CLT=cltMIND>If he wants me to come with him...
does he know about the <CLT=cltSTRONG>motive video<CLT=cltMIND>?
<CLT=cltMIND>But if he does...how did he find out?
